payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design an energetic, vibrant interface with bold block layouts, geometric shapes, high color contrast, large typography (32px+), animated background patterns, duotone effects. Perfect for startups and youth-focused apps. Use 4-6 contrasting colors from complementary/triadic schemes.
payload.best_for: Startups, creative agencies, gaming, social media, youth-focused, entertainment, consumer
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: flex/grid with large gaps (48px+), font-size: 32px+, background: animated patterns (CSS), color: neon/vibrant colors, animation: continuous pattern movement
payload.do_not_use_for: Financial institutions, healthcare, formal business, government, conservative, elderly
payload.effects_and_animation: Large sections (48px+ gaps), animated patterns, bold hover (color shift), scroll-snap, large type (32px+), 200-300ms
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Block layout with 48px+ gaps, ☐ Large typography 32px+, ☐ 4-6 vibrant colors max, ☐ Animated patterns active, ☐ Scroll-snap enabled, ☐ High contrast verified (7:1+)
payload.keywords: Bold, energetic, playful, block layout, geometric shapes, high color contrast, duotone, modern, energetic
payload.primary_colors: Neon Green #39FF14, Electric Purple #BF00FF, Vivid Pink #FF1493, Bright Cyan #00FFFF, Sunburst #FFAA00
payload.secondary_colors: Complementary: Orange #FF7F00, Shocking Pink #FF006E, Lime #CCFF00, triadic schemes
